titre: Synthesis Test n°3 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

I live in a small town. My town is quiet and clean. There is a big park near my house. Children play there every afternoon. There is a school, a hospital and a post office in my town. The market is in the centre. On Friday, my family goes to the market. We buy food and clothes. I love my town very much. It is a beautiful place to live.

Questions:
1) Where does he live? (1 pt)
2) What is there near his house? (1 pt)
3) Name two places in his town. (1 pts)
4) When does the family go to the market? (0.5 pt)
5) What do they buy? (0.5 pt)

Places - Match
Match each place with what you find or do there:
a) hospital
b) school
c) park
d) post office
( learn / play / doctor / letters )

Complete
Complete with: ( town - park - market - school )
a) I learn at ....... .
b) I play in the ....... .
c) I buy food at the ....... .
d) I live in a small ....... .

Grammar - Prepositions
Complete with: ( in - near - on )
a) The park is ....... my house.
b) We go to the market ....... Friday.
c) I live ....... a small town.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your town (the places and what you like).

Prices at the market.
Write the price in words.
1) 3 dinars = ..........
2) 10 dinars = ..........
